description: Packaging (measure contract section 3.3). Each case has levels: [unit, ...] and counts: [n, ...] (counts[0] is 1, counts[i] says how many of level i-1 level i holds). new: the packaging is built or fails PACKAGING_INVALID. convert: quantity converted to a unit at scale 6 HALF_EVEN and exact. breakdown: the quantity as whole units from the largest level down (expect an array of quantity objects).
howToRun: Build the packaging from the levels, then run each operation; compare quantities as plain text and unit code, or the error code with error.
